doors.description: Each dwelling unit's door: the walk from its outer side to the nearest storey exit (BYKHY 48/4).

exits.description:
Each storey holding rooms and how many storey exits it has (BYKHY 4/u): an escape stair's room, an open
stair's foot or head, a door to the outside on a storey at or below ±0.00.

rooms.description: Every room (space), a void and an outdoor one too.

sprinklers.description:
The building has an automatic sprinkler system, as the project's settings say (`.kcad` 226): the fire
regulation's sprinklered distances are the ones read (BYKHY 48/2, Ek-5/B; docs/adr/8057 §53).

units.description: The building program's groups that have rooms, with article 4's areas, in the program's order.

zoning.description:
The parcel's zoning (İmar durumu) and the building's areas against it, when the project writes one
(docs/adr/8057 §92).

AuditExample.description: One example: what the rule is given and what it must give.

architecture.description: What KentOS measures in an architectural drawing, given as data: `facts.project.architecture`.

features.description:
Objects as data (`{layer, geometry, attrs?}`, GeoJSON shapes, at most 500): a synthetic drawing is made of them
and measured (`facts.layers`, `facts.project`).

title.description: What it shows, in a few words ("8 m² yatak odası").

DoorEscape.description: A dwelling unit's door and its walk to the nearest storey exit.

exit.description: From its outer side; none when it opens into an escape stair's room or reaches no exit.

intoStair.description: It opens into an escape stair's room: it stands at its storey's exit (no walk, none needed).

EscapeWalk.description: A walk, along the points it turns at.

exits.description: A walk to an exit: how many exits its start reaches. None for a walk to a unit's door.

oneWay.description:
A walk to an exit: the part it shares with the walk to the nearest other exit, m (tek yön; a dead end's); all
of it with one exit. None for a walk to a unit's door.

path.description: Its points, from its start to its end.

Expected.description: The findings an example must give.

count.description: How many findings, exactly (0: the rule finds nothing).

has.description: Findings it must have, each matched by one of the rule's.

ExpectedFinding.description: A finding the rule must give: every key given must match.

feature.description: The example's object it names (`featureId`), by its place in `features` from 0.

oneOf.description: Bağımsız bölüm: a flat, a shop, an office.
Ortak alan: a shared corridor, the stairs, a shaft.
Dış alan: a garden, a car park.
Eklenti: a place allocated to an independent unit (its `annexOf`).

Occupancy.description:
A unit's use as BYKHY Ek-5/B's rows name it, as KentOS Mimari reads it from the unit's nature (Daire, Büro,
Dükkân, Otel …): the row of its escape distances.

RoomEscape.description: A room's walks, from its farthest point: 40 cm in front of its walls (BYKHY 32/6).

entrance.description: A dwelling unit's room: to its unit's door, through its own rooms (48/2); none for another room.

exit.description: To the nearest storey exit (BYKHY 32/4); none when it reaches none.

hasEntrance.description: Whether its unit has a door on its storey (a dwelling unit's room only).

passages.description: Its doors and gaps without a sill: its exits for BYKHY 39/2.

storeyExits.description: Whether its storey has an exit it may walk to: through its own unit's rooms and the common ones (33/6-b).

axis.description: Its outline to the walls' axes, m²: what most uses' person loads read (BYKHY Ek-5/A).

broken.description: Its boundary could not be found round its seed: its areas are its drawn rings', and it has no walks.

escape.description: Its walks; none for a void, an outdoor or a broken room and an escape stair's room.

kind.description:
Its kind as the regulations read rooms, by its name or usage (KentOS Mimari's reading: Salon, Yatak odası,
Mutfak, Banyo, WC, Hol …); none for another room (a store, a study, a balcony).

narrow.description:
Its net width, m: the diameter of the largest circle inside its net outline, the regulations' narrow side
(dar kenar, PAİY 29/1 and 29/3); none for a broken room.

net.description: Its net area, m²: between the walls' inner faces, as article 4 measures it.

occupancy.description:
The use its name or usage names as BYKHY Ek-5/B's rows do (Otopark, Depo, Lokanta …), as Mimari denetim's
fire rules read a room outside a unit (docs/adr/8057 §82); none when they name none, or a dwelling's.

outdoor.description: Its usage's brief is an outdoor one (a balcony, a terrace).

stair.description: An escape stair's room (named or used so, no dwelling unit's own): reaching it is reaching the storey's exit.

usage.description: Its usage, as the program's briefs name it.

void.description: A void: a shaft, a lift shaft, an opening in the floor.

RoomKind.description: A room's kind, as Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 29 names the rooms of a dwelling (the passages too).

Severity.description: A finding's severity, as a rule gives it.

height.description: Its height, m; none when the project gives none.

level.description: The storey's id; none for the rooms on no storey.

UnitFacts.description: A program group's article 4 areas (Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 4/ğ), m².

annexGross.description: Its annexes' gross and net areas summed (an independent unit's; 0 for another group).

annexOf.description: An annex's independent unit, by its id.

dwelling.description: An independent unit that is a dwelling (BYKHY 48 reads its rooms).

general.description: BB genel brüt alanı (4/ğ-2): its total and its part; none without a part.

gross.description: BB brüt alanı (4/ğ-1): its rooms' outer contour, a wall it shares cut at its axis.

levels.description: Each storey's part of its gross and net.

nature.description: What the deed calls it (Daire, Dükkân, Büro, Depo).

net.description: BB net alanı (4/ğ-3): its rooms' net areas, voids and outdoor rooms out.

number.description: Its number, as the project writes it.

occupancy.description:
Its use as BYKHY Ek-5/B's rows name it, read from its nature (an annex's from its unit's; docs/adr/8057 §79);
none for a common or outdoor group and for a nature that names no use.

share.description: Its part of the common areas' gross, by the program's rule; none when the program shares nothing.

total.description: BB toplam brüt alanı (4/ğ-4): its gross and its annexes'.

UnitLevel.description: A group's areas on one storey, m².

ZoningFacts.description: The parcel's zoning and the building's areas against it, m² (PAİY 4/1-tt, 4/1-cccc, 5/5, 5/8, 21, 22).

cap.description: The 30 % of the parcel's emsal area the exempt rooms may take; none without an emsal.

coverage.description: TAKS the plan gives; none when it gives none.

coverageSource.description: Where its TAKS is read from, when it says.

far.description: Emsal (KAKS) the plan gives; none when it gives none.

farSource.description:
Where İmar durumu's emsal is read from, when it says (docs/adr/8140): the zoning certificate, or the zoning
plan's decision it was taken from.

floors.description: Katlar alanı (emsale konu alan): the rooms counted in and the rooms out of it past the 30 % (5/8).

footprint.description: Taban alanı: the ground storey's rooms counted (all rooms in a project without storeys).

layout.description:
The building's layout the plan sets, as the project says it (yapı nizamı, docs/adr/8141): `detached`, `attached`,
`block`, `twin`; absent: not said. PAİY 5/6 reads the TAKS a plan does not give by it.

outside.description:
Emsal harici apart from the 30 % (5/8's own list: fire stairs and their halls; in the basements,
docs/adr/8148, a storey wholly under the ground's common areas, the shelter's least area, a masjid's 150 or
300 m², the children's rooms' 100 m², the car parks up to twice the mandatory ones' area).

over.description: The exempt rooms' area past the 30 %, counted in the floors' area.

parcel.description: Net imar parseli alanı, as the project's İmar durumu writes it (the ratios are over it, PAİY 5/5).
